items.title: Make the mastery goal CTA reach the participant-bound rematch corridor
items.why: ProgressionDebrief emits vaultfront-mastery-rematch, but no production listener exists.
items.recipe: Create one typed continuation event and consume it through WinModal's existing participant-bound rematch authority; prove lifecycle and idempotency.

executionLog.note: Typed match-scoped coordinator now routes mastery continuation into the participant-bound WinModal rematch authority; lifecycle tests pass.

items.title: Fail closed after fatal server exceptions
items.why: Master and Worker record fatal errors but continue accepting work.
items.recipe: Coordinate readiness, admission drain, bounded crash export, and exactly-once nonzero exit with injected-process tests.

executionLog.note: Master and Worker now stop admission, drain, export crash telemetry, and request exactly one bounded nonzero exit; injected tests pass.

items.title: Persist replay manifests across worker restarts and shards
items.why: Production replay routes default to bounded process memory.
items.recipe: Add PostgreSQL replay durability, hosted-mode selection, retention, and restart/cross-instance tests.

executionLog.note: Signed replay manifests use shared PostgreSQL in configured runtimes, fail closed without it, retain 30 days, and round-trip across backend instances.

items.title: Make the advertised artificial-intelligence cap fleet-wide
items.why: The hard cap is enforced independently in every worker process.
items.recipe: Use an atomic shared reservation backend with an hourly window and idempotent IDs; prove concurrent workers cannot exceed the cap.

executionLog.note: Remote AI reservations now use one atomic PostgreSQL hourly row across workers; a concurrent shared-backend test proves the cap cannot overrun.

items.title: Reject abusive traffic before allocating large JSON bodies
items.why: Coarse limits run after five-megabyte parsing and Worker installs JSON parsing twice.
items.recipe: Move admission before parsing, apply route-family body budgets, remove duplicate parsing, and test ordering/oversize behavior.

executionLog.note: Coarse admission runs before allocation, ordinary JSON is capped at 64 KiB, and only the archive corridor receives the explicit 5 MiB budget.

items.title: Turn the shared modal into a real accessible dialog
items.why: OModal lacks dialog semantics, focus lifecycle, inert ownership, and a keyboard-operable close control.
items.recipe: Add labelled semantics, 44px button, focus trap/restoration, nested-safe inert handling, DOM tests, and Playwright proof.

executionLog.note: OModal now owns labelled dialog semantics, 44px close control, nested-safe inert isolation, focus trap/restoration, DOM tests, and six rendered theme/viewport captures.

items.title: Validate Match Oracle input before provider reservation
items.why: Arbitrary body fields enter the provider prompt while cache identity truncates them.
items.recipe: Parse one strict normalized Zod object and derive both prompt and cache key from it before budget reservation.

executionLog.note: Match Oracle accepts one bounded normalized roster, derives prompt and cache identity from server-owned ratings, and rejects instruction-shaped identities before reservation.

items.title: Dispose listeners and rendering resources across rematches
items.why: NameLayer and StructureIconsLayer own resize listeners and GPU resources but have no dispose method.
items.recipe: Implement idempotent listener/canvas/stage/renderer disposal and lifecycle regressions.

executionLog.note: NameLayer and StructureIconsLayer now dispose resize/event subscriptions, DOM canvases, Pixi resources, maps, and stages idempotently.

items.title: Derive coverage ownership for trust-critical modules
items.why: The manual baseline predates current auth, proxy, AI-budget, evidence, and crash owners.
items.recipe: Derive required owners from policy/state/release contracts and fail closed when a measured floor is missing.

executionLog.note: Coverage ownership derives from release-critical state, route policy, auth, proxy, AI, evidence, and crash contracts; 24 owners and 32 measured floors pass.

items.title: Publish one canonical vaultfront.io contact identity
items.why: Public surfaces expose a nested studio-domain address and founder mail.
items.recipe: Use contact@vaultfront.io everywhere, reject identity leakage in source, and verify Zoho send/receive/reply-as separately.

executionLog.note: All public surfaces now use only contact@vaultfront.io and leakage tests pass. Live Zoho send/receive/reply-as proof remains a separate release gate pending the missing zoho.mail.admin capability.

items.title: Restore the canonical capability map after signed propagation
items.why: The propagated scripts/lib/secrets.mjs now reads only secrets/CAPABILITY_MAP.json, which does not exist in VaultFront, so project call sites see zero of the 72 Studio capabilities and corruption degrades silently instead of failing closed.
items.coreLoopStep: admission to uninterrupted match and release operations
items.recipe: Retain legacy single-value normalization while restoring Studio-Ops-base plus project-override capability composition, loud typed corruption failure, and isolated regression tests for absent, corrupt, deduplicated, and layered maps.

executionLog.note: Studio-base plus project-override capability composition and typed corruption failure are restored alongside the legacy adapter; 4/4 tests pass and the live gateway resolves 72 capabilities.

items.title: Give the post-match decision one visual primary and one secondary reveal
items.why: WinModal correctly recommends one continuation but simultaneously renders feedback, mutator voting, exit, share, rematch, clip, highlight, and result-card actions; live human evidence is zero, so the choice density is unvalidated.
items.coreLoopStep: reward to deliberate progression and next match
items.recipe: Keep the policy-selected continuation and exit visible, move optional sharing, mutator, clip, and result-card actions behind an accessible progressive disclosure, preserve telemetry, and add DOM plus rendered theme/mobile proof.

executionLog.note: The actual WinModal now keeps one recommended continuation plus Exit visible, collapses optional reward/social actions behind a 44px disclosure, and gains bounded mobile scrolling. Real-component desktop/mobile three-theme proof and 16/16 focused tests pass.

items.title: Make the progression hub a first-class three-theme surface
items.why: CommandCenter and FortuneCollectionPanel hardcode dark colors, Fortune equip has no 44px action floor or announced error outcome, and command-center is absent from the 132-capture theme receipt.
items.coreLoopStep: earned reward to visible progression choice
items.recipe: Move the hub to VaultFront semantic tokens, add accessible equip busy/success/error feedback and 44px actions, then add Command Center desktop/mobile captures and contrast assertions for dark, light, and competitive themes.

executionLog.note: Command Center now receives reachable global styles and semantic theme tokens; Fortune states use theme-safe rarity/success/danger colors, announced equip outcomes, and 44px controls. The final CANON-053 receipt binds 138 reviewed captures and passes the visual checker.

items.title: Turn the truthful Alpha Pulse into a contribution path
items.why: The visible pulse truthfully says Unmeasured and links to evidence, but live staging has zero events and offers no direct path from an interested visitor to Obelisk sign-in and a certified First Extraction run.
items.coreLoopStep: public interest to authenticated first match to feedback
items.recipe: Add a privacy-safe Join the Alpha action with explicit sign-in/play states, preserve unmeasured truth, route through the existing Obelisk account boundary and Play page, and instrument only the existing authenticated pulse after real participation.

executionLog.note: The public Alpha Pulse now routes signed-out visitors through the Studio account boundary and authenticated players into existing matchmaking; only real match telemetry can advance evidence. Tests pass 5/5.

items.title: Document the shipped loop without fabricating Soul fidelity
items.why: context/GAME_LOOP.md and docs/PLAYTESTS are absent, while the public SOUL intentionally contains no creative pillars; a numeric Soul-fidelity score therefore has no evidence authority.
items.coreLoopStep: input through certified fantasy, reward, and progression
items.recipe: Create a public-safe code-derived GAME_LOOP contract with authoritative sources, timing, reward fan-out, known evidence gaps, and an explicit N/A Soul boundary; do not invent founder-owned pillars or synthetic playtests.

executionLog.note: A public-safe source-bound GAME_LOOP contract now documents all six stages, authority boundaries, live 0/12 evidence, and an explicit Soul N/A boundary; 2/2 contract tests pass.

items.title: Keep startup intelligence artifacts out of the public repository
items.why: Startup created untracked context/SIGNALS.md and portfolio/compiled/FORECAST_LEDGER.json even though AGENTS.md keeps internal planning and detailed Studio process surfaces in the private control plane.
